text: Write a file format header that makes the file self-describing. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: String[] file = { "___",             // a version, so incompatibility is detected
"___",             // a header, so columns are found not counted
explanation: A version, a header, a comment convention, and a stated encoding are the four things that let someone who has never seen your format work out what it means. The header earns its place beyond readability: a reader that consults it tolerates reordered or added columns, where one that counts positions cannot. All four cost a few lines and a file format cannot be refactored once someone has a file.
